column1: # Every external URL cited anywhere in this repository MUST appear in this file
# with the HTTP status observed when it was last checked. This prevents the
# curriculum from accumulating invented or silently-rotted links.
#   403  -> reachable but blocks automated requests (usually bot protection);
#           treat as valid, verify manually in a browser before relying on it
#   000  -> connection/TLS failure from this machine, do not cite
